description: Defines the interface for an FAPI decorator class, including notifier management and chaining functionality within the ocudu::fapi namespace.

classes.name: fapi_decorator
classes.description: An abstract class representing a decorator for FAPI, managing various notifier objects and supporting chaining of decorators.

methods.name: get_p7_last_request_notifier
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the P7 last request notifier.

methods.name: get_p7_requests_gateway
methods.description: Pure virtual method to retrieve the P7 requests gateway.

methods.name: set_p7_indications_notifier
methods.description: Pure virtual method to set the P7 indications notifier.

methods.name: set_error_indication_notifier
methods.description: Pure virtual method to set the error indication notifier.

methods.name: set_p7_slot_indication_notifier
methods.description: Pure virtual method to set the P7 slot indication notifier.

methods.name: get_p7_indications_notifier
methods.description: Returns the P7 indications notifier, either from the next decorator or from this decorator.

methods.name: get_error_indication_notifier
methods.description: Returns the error indication notifier, either from the next decorator or from this decorator.

methods.name: get_p7_slot_indication_notifier
methods.description: Returns the P7 slot indication notifier, either from the next decorator or from this decorator.

methods.name: connect_notifiers
methods.description: Connects this decorator's notifiers to the next decorator in the chain.

methods.name: get_p7_indications_notifier_from_this_decorator
methods.description: Returns the P7 indications notifier of this decorator (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: get_error_indication_notifier_from_this_decorator
methods.description: Returns the error indication notifier of this decorator (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: get_p7_slot_indication_notifier_from_this_decorator
methods.description: Returns the P7 slot indication notifier of this decorator (to be implemented by subclasses).
